vocabulary.definition: to ride on the surface of water or another liquid on a board
vocabulary.example: The skilled surfer effortlessly surfs through the big waves.

vocabulary.definition: the outermost atmosphere of the Sun or another star
vocabulary.example: During a solar eclipse, the corona of the Sun becomes visible as a glowing halo.

vocabulary.definition: the plural form of radius, a straight line from the center to the circumference of a circle or sphere
vocabulary.example: The spacecraft crossed within 8.8 solar radii of the Sun's surface.

vocabulary.definition: a material that does not easily allow heat, electricity, or sound to pass through it
vocabulary.example: The thick foam acted as an insulator, keeping the interior of the spacecraft cool.

vocabulary.definition: the action of changing the direction of something
vocabulary.example: The shield was designed to provide deflection of solar energy away from the spacecraft.
The mission provided an unprecedented opportunity to study the Sun up close.
